# Python Async API Reference

This page documents `vl_convert.asyncio`. For a usage example, see {doc}`advanced/python-async`.

These entries are generated from the async type stubs and share the synchronous functions' parameter documentation. See [Types](#types) for the types used by both APIs.

Await functions marked `async`. Functions without that marker return directly and must not be awaited. The return type shown for an async function is the value returned by `await`.
